immigration.text: He supports strict immigration enforcement, removal of people here unlawfully, and limited legal pathways with sponsorship requirements.
immigration.quote: I support secure borders, enforced immigration law, strict and limited legal pathways, sponsorship, employer accountability, assimilation, and citizenship.

abortion.text: In a 2022 interview, he said he opposed limits during the first trimester but favored making abortions harder to obtain in the second and third trimesters.
abortion.quote: I would ask most people where their line in the sand is. There is no definite line. A lot of times, people put the line after the first trimester, and I would agree.

voting.text: He supports requiring documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a transition period and help obtaining the documents.
voting.quote: If government requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, citizens should first receive a reasonable transition period to obtain necessary records affordably or free.

tax.text: Schwartzel says he will keep taxes low and reduce regulations to help small businesses.
tax.quote: He will fight to keep taxes low, eliminate burdensome regulations, and make it easier for small businesses to thrive.

immigration.text: He supports finishing the border wall, enforcing immigration laws, and returning people who enter illegally and break the law.
immigration.quote: Jim firmly believes that anyone entering our country illegally and breaking our laws should be sent back to where they came from.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He opposes biological men competing in women’s sports and opposes bringing gender ideology into schools and sports.
gender.quote: Jim stands firmly against biological men competing in women’s sports and believes parents—not bureaucrats—should have the final say in how their children are raised and educated.
